page.title: Collect
page.lede: Bring in the feedback you already have and ask for more. Each one keeps the channel it came from, so you can filter by it later.

publicForm.title: Public form
publicForm.disabled: The link is off: anyone who opens it won't find the form. Turn it back on whenever you want, or generate a new one.
publicForm.limitReached: The link is on, but the Free plan is full: anyone who opens it sees a polite message and their feedback doesn't come in.
publicForm.active: One question, answered from a phone with no account needed. Share the link or print the QR code.

formLink.regenerateWarning: The current link and its QR code stop working right away. The new link is live.
formLink.failed: That didn't work. Try again shortly.

formQuestion.label: Form question
formQuestion.hint: If you leave it empty, the form asks "{question}"
formQuestion.saved: Saved. The form shows it right away.
formQuestion.failed: That didn't work. Try again shortly.

manualForm.intro: Copied from an email, Slack, or your notes, one at a time.
manualForm.feedbackPlaceholder: The customer's words, exactly as they wrote them
manualForm.added: Added. You'll find it among your feedback.
manualForm.limitReached: You've reached the Free plan limit: this feedback wasn't saved.

errors.text: Write the feedback text, {limit} characters at most.
errors.channel: Write where it came from, {limit} characters at most.
errors.receivedAt: Pick a date today or in the past.

csvImport.sizeError: The file is over 1 MB. Split it into several files and import them one at a time.
csvImport.intro: You need a text column. Channel, customer, and date are optional. Up to {max} rows and 1 MB. Before saving you'll see what comes in and which rows don't; feedback already saved won't be duplicated.
csvImport.toImport: {count, plural, one {1 feedback to import} other {{n} feedback to import}}
csvImport.overLimitNoneOne: No room left: the new feedback stays out.
csvImport.overLimitNoneMany: No room left: {n} new feedback stay out.
csvImport.overLimitSome: We're importing the first {n} valid rows, the other {m} stay out.
csvImport.invalidHeading: {count, plural, one {1 invalid row} other {{n} invalid rows}}
csvImport.invalidHint: These aren't imported. Fix them in the file and upload it again: rows already imported won't be duplicated.
csvImport.ignoredDuplicates: {count, plural, one {1 already there} other {{n} already there}}
csvImport.ignoredInvalid: {count, plural, one {1 invalid row} other {{n} invalid rows}}
csvImport.missingColumnFound: Missing the text column. Columns found: {columns}.
csvImport.missingColumnNone: Missing the text column in the file's first row.
csvImport.onlyHeader: The file only has a header, no feedback.
csvImport.tooManyRows: The file has {rows} rows, the maximum is {max}. Split it into several files.
csvImport.textTooLong: The text has {length} characters, the maximum is {max}.
csvImport.brokenQuotes: This row's quotes aren't closed or are misplaced: the text may have merged with the rows after it.
csvImport.extraColumns: This row has more columns than the header: there may be a comma in the text without quotes.
csvImport.invalidDate: The date "{value}" isn't valid. Use day/month/year, like 25/09/2026, or 2026-09-25.
csvImport.futureDate: The date {date} is in the future.
